## Description

Patients upload PDFs/photos via portal (or WhatsApp link) before a visit; AI worker + Azure Document Intelligence extract lab values, dates and diagnoses into trend charts tagged "Unverified · patient upload"; the doctor accepts each value in one click; the original file is always kept beside the extracted values.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Extracted values never enter verified trends until a clinician accepts them.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each extracted value links to the page/region of the original file.
- [ ] **AC3.** Uploads are malware-scanned and size/type limited; prompt-injection content in documents is ignored.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
